name: What types of patio doors are available for installation?

mainEntity.name: What types of patio doors are available for installation?

acceptedAnswer.text: There are several common types of patio doors, each offering different aesthetics and functionalities. Sliding patio doors, also known as bypass doors, are popular for their space-saving design. French patio doors, or hinged doors, offer a classic look and can open inward or outward. Bifold patio doors fold accordion-style to create large open spaces. Additionally, multi-slide patio doors offer wider openings than standard sliders. The best type depends on your space, design preferences, and desired functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common types include sliding, French, bifold, and multi-slide patio doors. Each offers different styles and operational methods to suit various needs.
